verdict: PASS within manual empty-island red/blue backdrop scope

originals.review_method: Lossless recompressed view opened with view_image; identical decoded original RGBA pixels verified

blue_view_derivative.reason: Original exceeded tool image-output size limit; PNG encoding compressed without changing any decoded pixel, dimension, mode or alpha.

alignment.validation: Four independent unchanged chrome/control anchors select the same integer shift. Add Objects and Render Engine patches have 99th-percentile absolute channel differences of at most 2 screenshot RGB units; no rescaling or warping used.
alignment.qualification: Observed framing adjustment, not an automatically synchronized window-position proof.

observations: The island body changes from a red tint to a blue tint with the controlled backdrop; the two captures preserve the same island/control geometry after framing alignment.
Fine vertical backdrop bands are strongly attenuated beneath the central empty bed while tab labels, icons, Default model chip and other foreground controls remain sharp.
Rounded outer contour and the inset composer contour remain intact; blue Send is visible without the tooltip that overlays it in red.
The empty placeholder is low contrast against the tinted bed; populated transcript and bright/dark contrast are separate pending evidence, not passed by this pair.
limits: User-supplied images and stage receipts are manually associated; no automatic stable capture or permission bypass occurred.
Screenshot RGB/band amplitudes are descriptive, not calibrated optical transmittance, opacity, accessibility contrast certification or a Windows alpha-equation test.
This pair does not qualify moved/resized/recreated windows, pill lifecycle, bright/dark populated transcript readability or full UI completion.
Original PNG hashes remain unchanged. No app query, input, launch or capture was performed for this review.
